FAQ

Service questions

Which areas do you serve?

We are based in Midrand, Gauteng, and serve Midrand and the surrounding areas. Contact us to confirm availability for your location.

Do you work on homes and businesses?

Yes. We work on houses and townhouses, offices and retail premises, workshops and light industrial units, and rental properties.

How do I get a quote?

Request an appointment or send an enquiry. We will arrange a site visit where needed and send a clear, itemised quote before any work begins.

Can solar keep my lights on during outages?

With a hybrid inverter and battery storage, yes. We size the system to the circuits and appliances you want to keep running.

What does an inspection include?

We check the distribution board, earthing and bonding, earth leakage and circuit protection, wiring, plugs and switches, and signs of overheating, then report findings by priority.

Need an electrician or a solar quote?

Book a site visit or send us the details. We will get back to you.
